lead.headline: Irish tech union grows five-fold amid AI-driven layoffs
lead.standfirst: While Dublin hosted the presidency’s International AI Summit, a Workers’ AI Counter Summit met the weekend before, Politico Europe reports.
body: The Digital and Techworker Alliance, founded in 2023, had around 270 members in its first year and a half and now has more than 1,350, its organiser told the outlet.
lead.more: Irish tech workers unionise as AI-driven layoffs spread (Politico Europe).

stories.headline: From the archive: tracking digital skill needs in online job ads
stories.standfirst: A Cedefop policy brief dated 20 October 2023.
body: Using Cedefop analysis of online job advertisements, it showed the demand for digital skills across the EU-27 and argued for faster implementation of digital policy and for up- and reskilling.
stories.more: From the archive (2023): Going digital means skilling for digital.

stories.headline: From the archive: how qualifications govern access to occupations
body: Qualifications define what a person needs to know and be able to do to carry out an activity on the labour market. Health and safety, consumer protection and quality assurance are quoted to justify them, but they may also defend the private interests of professional groups, the study notes.
stories.more: From the archive (2013): the role of qualifications in governing occupations.

stories.headline: In AI hub Montreal, young graduates weigh chances against fears
stories.standfirst: Some students and newcomers expect new opportunities; others fear their skills will soon be outdated, Le Monde reports (subscription).
stories.more: Montreal’s young graduates and AI (Le Monde, subscription).

stories.headline: Agency board changes for Cedefop, Eurofound and EU-OSHA
stories.standfirst: The Council replaced a member of Cedefop’s Management Board for Bulgaria (decision of 24 September).
body: It also replaced a member and an alternate for Denmark at Eurofound (9 October) and members for Estonia and Cyprus at EU-OSHA (1 October).
stories.more: Board changes at Cedefop, Eurofound and EU-OSHA (Official Journal).

stories.headline: Teachers and trainers are key agents of change, says the ETF
stories.standfirst: As AI and the green transition reshape labour markets, the ETF argues for investing in the educators who support young people and adults throughout their learning.
stories.more: ETF: why investing in teachers and trainers matters.

stories.headline: HR professionals see AI reshaping their roles more than taking jobs
stories.standfirst: Their insecurity is mostly about changing role expectations rather than job loss, and self-directed workplace learning helps them regain agency.
stories.more: AI and HR professionals: workplace learning as a buffer (Journal of Workplace Learning).

stories.headline: Nine VETNET papers from ECER 2026 mention Cedefop
stories.standfirst: Published on 13 October in the VETNET Conference Series.
body: They include studies of AI-mediated vocational pedagogy, embodied AI role-play in extended reality for retail apprentices, and an inclusive VET ecosystem.
stories.more: Nine VETNET conference papers mention Cedefop.

lives.headline: German concrete builders win world gold after training around their jobs
lives.standfirst: Jakob Distler and Tim Arnold beat eight teams in concrete construction at WorldSkills 2026 in Shanghai.
body: Four days at their physical limit, they told the Deutsche Handwerks Zeitung; when the concrete for a staircase came out far too liquid, they formed a lid over the step and still finished on time. They trained from April, every two to three weeks with their national trainer in Nördlingen and on evenings at home, with their bosses giving them the time. Their Chinese rivals, they observed, train for years. Now, they say, they pass their enthusiasm for the trade on to the new apprentices.
